previous_ladder.note: 10/20/30% shadow doses are owned by scripts/build_mass_shadow.py; this session adds only new (MASS, value) pairs and re-derives them from the same parent with the same gate.

ranking.used_shadow: exclusive kernel credit, ascending, recomputed after each deletion (src/mass.py)
ranking.rejected_fifo: the parent's stored 8-connected FIFO-BFS visit order, descending: spatially concentrated, one contiguous 632-block hole at the 40% dose
ranking.rejected_shadow50: 50% shadow drop: the greedy starts emptying whole contiguous regions (largest emptied cluster 17 blocks = 425 km2)

matched_count_comparison_at_40pct.note: REPORT ONLY: at the same 15,062 removals this is how much more explainable credit the credit-blind and stored-order sets destroy than the shadow set does

region_evenness_gate.why: Hard Constraint #5 forbids region-isolated files. Every candidate must remove mass spatially evenly, which the parent's stored FIFO-BFS order does not.

leakage_canary.reason: No feature band and no label is read: every ranking is a deterministic function of the parent's own dot coordinates. Nothing new can leak.

catalogue_hide_recover.reason: R0 was already pruned against the full catalogue, so a catalogue holdout cannot separate real new-fault credit from the collar; it would only reward mass. Report-only instrument, never a gate.

sgmc_control.reason: No fold-clean SGMC control is calibrated for a mass-only subset edit.

variants.ranking: ascending exclusive 300 m kernel credit, recomputed after each deletion (src/mass.py)
variants.predicted_change: +0.014 DTI (MODEL; bracket +0.004 to +0.025; not a score)

model_bracket.basis: ladder-anchored continuation of the recorded 10/20/30% predictions; first-order credit term bracketed over unobservable c and |G|. Assumptions, not measurements.

variants.form_note: h33-h33-2-b2; MASS shadow-drop 40% -> 22592 dots; predicted +0.014 MODEL

mechanism_card.hypothesis: Deleting the 40% of R0 dots with the least exclusive 300 m kernel credit continues to raise live DTI, because the mass term is paid per dot while kernel credit is a max over dots inside 300 m; a credit-blind deletion of the same size should gain less.
mechanism_card.mechanism: D = 0.2T + 0.2(S-M) + 0.8|G| charges 0.2 per unit of predicted mass but credits T only once per truth pixel. A dot whose disk is already covered by closer neighbours pays its full 0.2 share and supplies almost no T, so deleting it lowers D by 0.2(1-c) while T barely moves. Ranking by exclusive credit (the credit only that dot supplies, recomputed after each deletion) minimises the unobservable T loss per unit mass removed. The 40% and 50% doses test whether that gain keeps compounding or turns over once strands start to be eaten.
mechanism_card.non_fault_confounder: Exclusive credit is truth-free. A dot can have near-zero exclusive credit and still be the only dot covering a genuine new strand that lies in the shadow of a mapped one; lithologic contacts, drainage margins and topographic lineaments are shadowed identically. Deep doses thin every trace, so a negative result at 40-50% is as consistent with 'the removed strands were real' as with 'the metric punishes sparse coverage'.
mechanism_card.matched_count_control: random-drop 40% removes 15,062 dots drawn uniformly at random with a recorded seed: same dose, same spatial distribution in expectation, blind to kernel credit. At matched count the random set destroys +0.0% more exclusive credit than the shadow set (shadow E=92598, this arm E=92598, of 255848 total).
mechanism_card.competing_prediction: The structural report contradicts the credit argument in the opposite direction. R0 carries 838 strands of >=10 dots (>=1 km) at 5 px linking; this arm keeps 0 of them and raises mean dot spacing from 3.7 px to 6.2 px (100% of dots farther than the 3 px kernel from their nearest neighbour). If new-fault truth is line-like, T depends on along-strike continuity and this arm could score BELOW the credit-blind control even though it destroys less exclusive credit. Both predictions are recorded; the paired live receipts decide, and |delta| < 0.010 is no evidence.
mechanism_card.predicted_live_change: +0.014 DTI (MODEL; bracket +0.004 to +0.025; not a score)
mechanism_card.model_bracket: first-order bracket +0.0040 to +0.0250 DTI; ladder-anchored point estimate. Brackets are assumptions, not measurements, and a live delta below 0.010 is no evidence.
mechanism_card.falsifier: A same-week paired live receipt against R0 with delta <= -0.005 at 40% falsifies the dose direction. If rand40 lands within 0.005 of shadow40, the exclusive-credit ranking adds nothing and the ladder is really a pure mass effect; if rand40 beats shadow40 by >= 0.005 the ranking is wrong and must be abandoned. |delta| < 0.010 is no evidence either way.
mechanism_card.structural_geologist_note: Review the deleted dots as a map. At 40-50% whole short strands and trace tips leave and the mean dot spacing grows from 3 px (300 m) to 6-7 px (600-700 m), i.e. beyond the metric's own kernel radius. If the survivors still chart as strike-consistent lineaments, the deletion is defensible; where a deleted dot closed a step-over or a mapped-trace termination, the deletion is geologically wrong and a negative live result should be believed.
